name: FactoryBench
description: FactoryBench is a benchmark for evaluating machine-behavior reasoning over industrial robotic telemetry, structured around Pearl's causal hierarchy. Q&A pairs span four reasoning levels: state identification, intervention reasoning, counterfactual analysis, and engineering decision-making (troubleshooting and optimisation).
citation: Merzouki et al., FactoryBench: Evaluating Industrial Machine Understanding, 2026. Preprint.

rai:dataUseCases: FactoryBench measures machine understanding reasoning over industrial robotic telemetry across Pearl's causal hierarchy. Validity has been established for zero-shot benchmark evaluation of LLMs and time-series models on structured industrial Q&A reasoning tasks (state, intervention, counterfactual, decision-making). Not validated for training production control models or transfer to open-domain Q&A.
rai:dataLimitations: Domain-specific to factory and industrial robotic scenarios; may not generalise to open-domain Q&A tasks. Faults are atomic and drawn from a closed catalogue of 27 physically injected mechanisms, which differs from compound or gradual real-world faults. Level 3 counterfactual ground truth is approximate: two real runs cannot share an identical pre-injection state, so the signature-kernel-MMD-selected CF pair is an empirical proxy for the do-operation, and L3 scores therefore conflate model reasoning with proxy quality. Not recommended for safety-critical deployment decisions or evaluation outside industrial robotic telemetry.
rai:dataBiases: Selection bias towards industrial cobot/arm workflows (UR, KUKA, Yu-Cobot) and their controller terminology; limited diversity of robot platforms and tasks. Size imbalance between levels 2 and 3. Templated questions may favour models tuned to fixed-format benchmarks.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains no personal or sensitive information across any of the standard categories (Gender, Socio-economic status, Geography, Language, Age, Culture, Experience or Seniority, Health or medical data, Political or religious beliefs). All data was collected from industrial robots with no human subjects involved.
rai:dataSocialImpact: FactoryBench supports research on industrial fault diagnosis, predictive maintenance, and engineer-assistant deployments, and surfaces capability gaps in current LLMs (scores below 50% on L1-3 and below 18% on L4). Key risks are misreading benchmark scores as operational readiness and premature deployment of unverified LLM assistants in safety-critical settings; privacy and demographic harms do not apply (sensor-only data, no human subjects). Mitigations: evaluation-only design intent (L4 excluded from training and validation), a three-vendor LLM-as-judge ensemble with median voting for L4, and a versioned release track. Not to be used to certify models for safety-critical deployment without expert validation.
rai:syntheticDataDescription: Q&A pairs are algorithmically generated from real robotic telemetry signals using structured question templates. The underlying sensor data is collected from physical UR3 and KUKA KR10 robots executing pick-and-place, screwing, and peg-in-hole tasks at 83-125 Hz with systematic fault injection, supplemented with AURSAD and voraus-AD datasets.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: Q&A generation
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: Deterministic template engine generates Q&A from telemetry episodes and root-cause labels. Each item carries a provenance record; Level 4 items include a root_cause field for LLM-as-judge scoring. No crowd annotators.
